message: I take quinapril at my usual dose every morning. Is it okay to have it with grapefruit juice?
response_text: It is not recommended to take quinapril with grapefruit juice [1]. Grapefruit juice can increase the risk of hypotension when taken with certain medications, including ACE inhibitors like quinapril. Always take your medication with a glass of water and follow your healthcare provider's instructions.

Quinapril (Accupril) is used to treat high blood pressure and to reduce the risk of heart attacks in people with heart disease [1]. It works by relaxing blood vessels so that blood can flow more easily [1].

Quinapril is used to treat high blood pressure [1]. It belongs to a class of drugs called angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors, which work by relaxing blood vessels to help blood flow more easily [1].
